• As a Graduate Teaching Assistant, I Supported students in mathematics and statistics by clarifying complex concepts, improving understanding, and enhancing performance.
  • Collaborated with the instructor to foster a positive learning environment and assisted in grading, feedback, and preparing instructional materials.
  • Held office hours to address student queries and provide individualized support.

• Built and deployed NLP chatbot using BERT and intent classification, automating support for 8M+ users and boosting satisfaction by a great extent; integrated with React Native for seamless UX.
  • Optimized inference and applied model quantization, cutting API usage and compute costs by around 20%. Integrated Elasticsearch to enhance knowledge retrieval, improving factual accuracy by 18%.
  • Developed an ML-based fraud detection system achieving 88% accuracy, leveraging machine learning models for real-time anomaly detection and distributed computing frameworks for scalable data processing, improving risk mitigation by 24%.
  • Collaborated within an Agile team of 50+ members, optimizing CI/CD pipelines using DevOps practices, containerization, and orchestration to accelerate deployments, reducing model rollout times.

• Built NLP PoCs for sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and text classification using spaCy, NLTK, and scikit-learn.
  • Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) and feature engineering on unstructured text datasets (e.g., product reviews, call center transcripts) to support downstream modeling tasks.
  • Built text classification models (SVM, Logistic Regression, Random Forest) to categorize customer feedback; improved F1-score from 0.72 to 0.84 through hyperparameter tuning.
  • Implemented simple retrieval-augmented workflows using TF-IDF and embedding-based similarity search with SBERT to support a QA assistant for internal documents. Created dashboards with Streamlit to visualize model outputs for stakeholder reviews.

• Worked on a Django-based web game that used tourist data from over 1 million annual visitors to Jaipur to create an interactive treasure hunt featuring 30+ historical landmarks.
  • Incorporated geo-location APIs and engaging storytelling, increasing user engagement by 60% and promoting local tourism while improving game retention by 35%.
